types.name: Block
types.doc: One entry in schema.blocks or in a container's blocks. Because LeafBlock's `type` is a plain string that could also read "group" or "page", comparing `type` does not narrow this union — use isGroup(), isPage() or isContainer() from core/tree.

types.name: ContainerBlock
types.doc: A block that holds other blocks.

types.name: EnableWhenCondition
types.doc: One visibility rule: "show my block when <question> <operator> <answer>". question is the block id of the condition source. matrix is not supported as a source in v1 — its Record<row, column> value has no single scalar this flat shape could reference. A matrix block can still be the target of someone else's condition. `id` is unique within the item's enableWhen and follows the code pattern (contract 15.1); enableLogic refers to conditions by it. The list's order is the condition numbering the author sees in the builder.

types.name: FormSchema
types.doc: Root shape of a published form schema. schemaVersion 1 and 2 are accepted (an absent version is 1); v1 is v2 without groups or pages. Any other version fails the integrity check. A form is paged if and only if its root holds pages; there is no mode flag.

members.name: title
members.doc: The form's title and, when the author wrote one, its description: plain text. The renderer never shows either; the host does, and owns the page's h1 (contract section 7).

members.name: drafts
members.doc: Where in-progress answers are kept (drafts contract section 2). Absent means "session".

types.name: GridBlock
types.doc: A table of fixed rows and typed columns, where every cell is its own input (contract section 14). Rows are a coded list. Required is per column: the grid's own `required` and `completeRequired` are ignored. Never a condition source. Its answer is codes only, `Record<rowCode, Record<columnCode, string>>`: a choice cell holds an option code of its column, a text cell the text. An empty cell, and a row with no answered cell, are absent.

types.name: GridColumn
types.doc: One column of a grid (contract section 14.1). Its `code` and `label` follow the coded-option rules (contract 13.2) and are unique among the grid's columns. A `radio` or `dropdown` column's `options` are its own coded list. Only `required: true` makes the column required: answered in every row.

types.name: GroupBlock
types.doc: A container of blocks, nestable to any depth. It has no value and is never required: its only effect is structural, and through enableWhen, hiding everything inside it. With `repeats: true` it is a repeating group (contract section 12): its `blocks` are the template for one instance, and the respondent fills it any number of times between `minOccurs` and `maxOccurs`. `repeatLabel`, `minOccurs` and `maxOccurs` are ignored on a group that does not repeat.

members.name: repeatLabel
members.doc: Singular noun for one instance, as it reads mid-sentence, e.g. "patient".

members.name: maxOccurs
members.doc: Whole number ≥ 1 and ≥ minOccurs. Absent means at most 1,000 (DEFAULT_MAX_OCCURS).

members.name: scores
members.doc: Calculated from the group's questions (contract section 17). Never on a page.

types.name: LeafBlock
types.doc: Anything in the tree that is not a container: every question and every presentational block. `type` is a plain string — the registry (not this type) determines whether a given type is actually renderable. An unknown type is refused at runtime, not at the type level: the integrity check throws in /core, and FormRenderer shows its "This form can't be shown" message and calls onRenderError (contract section 7).

members.name: description
members.doc: Help text, shown on answerable questions only, under the label and before the control; line breaks are kept. Blank ("" is how the builder exports cleared help) shows nothing.

members.name: captions
members.doc: video, file kind only: a .vtt captions file (contract section 10). Ignored on YouTube and Vimeo.

members.name: options
members.doc: choice, checkbox, multiselect, dropdown and ranking: the options; matrix: its rows (contract section 13). Answers and conditions use the codes.

members.name: enableLogic
members.doc: Custom logic over enableWhen's ids (contract section 15). Never together with enableBehavior.

types.name: LogicItem
types.doc: A condition id of the item, or a nested node.

types.name: LogicNode
types.doc: How an item's conditions combine (contract 15.1): `all` is true if and only if every item is, `any` if and only if at least one is. Exactly one key per node, holding a non-empty list; nesting depth is unlimited.

types.name: NavigationSettings

members.name: showProgress
members.doc: "Step x of y" above each page title. Default true.

members.name: progressStyle
members.doc: Default "caption". "bar" adds a display-only segmented bar above the caption. Used only when showProgress is on. A host's `data-zf-progress-style` on any wrapper overrides it either way.

members.name: reviewPage
members.doc: A review step after the last page, where the form is submitted. Default false.

types.name: Option
types.doc: One option of a coded list (contract section 13): a stable code, which answers and conditions use, and the label respondents see. The label is always plain text.

members.name: score
members.doc: A finite number, used by score formulas (contract section 17) on the options of choice, dropdown, checkbox and multiselect, and on matrix columns. Ignored anywhere else.

types.name: PageBlock
types.doc: One step of a paged form. Root level only, and if any root item is a page, every root item is. Like a group it has no value; its `title` is the step name.

types.name: ProgressStyle
types.doc: How progress is shown: the caption alone, or the caption with a segmented bar above it.
